newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: UN receives second, incomplete, Iraqi oil contract.
newsitem.headline: UN receives second, incomplete, Iraqi oil contract.

text.p: The United Nations has received a second oil contract from Iraq but it did not comply with proper procedures and a request was made for it to be resubmitted, U.N. spokeswoman Sylvana Foa said Tuesday.

Referring to the entry into force at 0501 GMT Tuesday of an "oil-for-food" agreement with Iraq permitting the sale of $2 billion worth of oil over six months, she said three of four U.N. oil overseers who scrutinize oil contracts were on duty at the time.
"Finally, a contract came through and they are now actively considering the first contract."
She added: "Evidently, a second (contract) was submitted but did not completely follow all the proper procedures you are supposed to follow and so it is being asked for a resubmission.
"So there are one and a half contracts -- one that is properly submitted and one that needs to be resubmitted."
Foa gave no details of either contract.
